candidate_workaround: Use the advertised record and witness subcommands after reading their exact help, instead of assuming add-method and add-witness aliases.
failure_signature: A help probe assumed nonexistent add-method and add-witness subcommands; argparse rejected both choices.
recurrence_guard: Use the top-level advertised command list, then read help for record and witness before composing a mutation command.
rollback: Give both rejected subcommand probes zero workflow credit and retain them before using the advertised commands.
scope_boundary: Method Flow CLI discovery only; no scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Discover Method Flow mutation subcommands from current help
trigger_preconditions: A Method Flow mutation command is being composed without current subcommand help.
